evals.prompt: /in-your-own-words I want pstack updated from its upstream source, but keep our Copilot changes and don't publish anything yet. Play back my goal and the problem before doing any work.
evals.expected_output: A concise goal and problem restatement, with no implementation or publication.
expectations: States that upstream improvements should be integrated while preserving the Copilot adaptation.
Does not edit files, start implementation, or claim the update is done.
